question: Which of the following options is NOT one of the meanings of the homonym 'advance'?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Special benefits**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"advance"** has multiple meanings, depending on its context. Below are its meanings with explanations:
 
 
• **Move forward** (आगे बढ़ना): This refers to physically or metaphorically moving ahead in position or progress.
 
 
• **Example:** The soldiers were ordered to advance towards the enemy's position.
 
 
 
 
• **Progress** (प्रगति): It signifies improvement or development in a particular aspect.
 
 
• **Example:** The advance in technology has made communication much easier.
 
 
 
 
• **Ahead of time** (समय से पहले): This refers to doing or planning something before it is required or due.
 
 
• **Example:** She made the payment in advance to secure her reservation.
 
 
 
 
• However, **Special benefits** (विशेष लाभ) is NOT a meaning of the word "advance." This eliminates Option 3 as the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Special benefits**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Move forward** (आगे बढ़ना): Refers to making physical or figurative progress.
 
 
• **Example:** The team decided to move forward with their plan despite the challenges.
 
 

 
• **Progress** (प्रगति): Refers to development or improvement in a particular field or situation.
 
 
• **Example:** The progress in medical research has saved countless lives.
 
 

 
• **Ahead of time** (समय से पहले): Refers to completing or planning something earlier than required.
 
 
• **Example:** We prepared the presentation ahead of time to avoid last-minute stress.
